name: quiz-gomes
description: Quiz competitivo mobile-first com React, Cloudflare Workers, D1 e Durable Objects.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @quiz-gomes/domain && npm run build -w @quiz-gomes/web && npm run build -w @quiz-gomes/worker
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:migrations && npm run build
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: node scripts/assert-cloudflare-production.mjs && npm run test:migrations && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run deploy:cloudflare -w @quiz-gomes/worker
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @quiz-gomes/domain && npm run typecheck -w @quiz-gomes/web && npm run typecheck -w @quiz-gomes/worker
